_about: Machine-readable summary of docs/research-map/DIRECTIONS.md (15 November 2026). Options, not instructions. Evidence keys refer to corpus.json. Costs assume Qwen3-4B FP8 in the AdaMEM harness on one 12 GB GPU (about 9 GPU hours per arm for 60 tasks x 3 seeds); with volunteers, divide calendar time by the number of machines (cells: two arms, 20 named tasks, one seed, one machine).
invariants: banks built from train only, frozen before evaluation
frozen task list named by game path, with SHA-256
same step limit in every arm; same retrieved-text budget (k, tokens) in every memory arm
decision rules, equivalence margins and comparison families written before the run
per-task paired sign-flip permutation test, two-sided, Holm within a family
raw runs frozen; negative results published as results

directions.question: Q0: does AdaMEM's published gain reproduce in our setting? (a near-reproduction: MiniLM instead of Qwen3-Embedding-4B)
prerequisites: bank from own train runs (full bank about 180 GPU h, splittable across volunteers)

directions.question: Q1: does retrieval beat a random entry of the same task type? how large is each rung?
arms: intermediate: whole trajectory by task refreshed every step
optional placebo: same length, other task types

Q2: unit of retrieval and refresh

arms: rungs 0, 3, 5 x Qwen3-1.7B / Qwen3-4B / optional Qwen3-8B-AWQ
